# Refined Vision — conveyor buildout

## Refined vision

Four tranche reviews carry the refined vision of the conveyor buildout programme. Three decided `continue` and one `pause`; the pause and the later continuation both concern tranche `01a1e9e0-e2ac-786b-ac48-3b8bcdf12188`.

Review 1 (2026-11-18) continued on B0, the accepted definition set taken in that review; its six benefit profiles are each "not measured" with a method, owner and kata, its risk register was open on #97 the live engine proof, the 43 due-now outputs and the unstaffed BCM, and programme rows were 0. Its output document is `01a1eb18-6752-72ff-9c28-cd4a94217de7`. Review 2 (2026-11-21) continued with the management, governance and boundary baselines plus scope baselines for S02, T1 and T11, and recorded all three project manifests green at `d367a4a992ca5338c82466e9d6ef308e62b01ba6` — S02 (P2 long-job proof landed; issue #2 closes with the lane PR), T1 (no contemporaneous governance record; retrospective reconstruction) and T11 (mechanism and tests claimed; no calibrated C0-C5 threshold row). B1–B6 stood at `draft`.

Review 3 (2026-11-21T23:24) paused tranche `01a1e9e0-e2ac-786b-ac48-3b8bcdf12188` at snapshot `7ff27efd65146630e62d9c235458be789fb68c14`: S03 was red on 5 checks and T2 red on 4, on the conditions that both manifests are green at the closing snapshot, both projects close on a conformant review or a real waiver, and each finding carries one retro lesson. Its four open risks include no human accepting owner in the tenant for a non-conformant waiver, branch migrations 0062/0063 unapplied on the live primary, five open P0 code findings programme-wide, and v1-t2-3, v1-t2-6, v1-t2-5 and v1-s03-2 open and owned; its output document is `01a2006a-8db7-764e-9b21-fee33e71e815`. Review 4 (2026-11-22) continued the same tranche with scope baselines S03 `01a20063-7af8-727b-b092-24de3821d204` and T2 `01a2005c-5a4f-7eb5-a004-ccb5545eb6fb`, and fixes a target for each benefit reference: B1 every choice has a decision row; B2 every service a job uses is a toolkit, and a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified; B3 one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence and a second is repeatable; B4 at least one outside contribution changes a published output and every output is reachable; B5 the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store and the registry has one home; B6 the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review. Each profile remains `draft` on the baseline "not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project)", and review 4 states that no risk is waived except the owner-accepted S14 residual.

## Changes from the mandate

Seventeen change rows are registered against fifteen distinct baseline references. Twelve are the retrospective MSP/TOGAF/SAFe rework of one project each under the owner's 2026-11-21 scope change (#526): the missing artefacts are provided retroactively, the record is taken through the full lifecycle and the project is re-closed through the gates. Each was decided on 2026-11-21 by the programme owner's standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`, is recorded in #526, rebuilds and republishes the project's record and declared outputs, leaves the delivery tranche unchanged and carries no separate cost baseline. Sixteen rows are `accepted` (12) or `approved` (4); one is `open`.

Four approved rows fall outside the rework. "Accept the retrospective WBS deliverable for T13" records that the scope baseline freezes the plan and that recording the deliverable's acceptance with its evidence is the one change it makes to it. "Record the B2 benefit baseline" measures B2 (less bespoke tooling) against the live record at the 2026-11-22 snapshot, its target being that every service a job uses is a toolkit and a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified. `U3-REBASELINE` re-baselines tranches 9–13 to the accepted management baseline v2 with zero cost and schedule impact and its scope recorded as a record correction. "Record the six benefit profile baselines and six field groups" authorises the B1–B6 profile fields to cite the measured baselines, the profiles having carried a baseline that was not yet a measurement and incomplete groups, with the measurements held in `benefit_measurement`.

The one open row, `U5-ACCEPTANCE-STANDARD` at severity P1, replaces the acceptance standard with v5 §5 clauses (a)-(j): a project is done only when every gate clause is discharged by executable checks with an explicit kind (record/probe/code); every mandatory artefact is evidenced with a published document; every P0/P1 package is resolved; every gate records a rule decision with a resolving `delegation_ref`; outputs are published at the head; the SAFe rows exist; a Phase-G review with `snapshot_sha` triages findings; the risk, ADR and benefit registers are operated; no finding and no waiver is open; and the published pack is current at the head. No deferral is a disposition. It is blocked by v1-change-1 — the change gate's approval reads `meta.change_id`, which `approvals.request` does not write — and is not approved while that fix is in flight, since approving it earlier would be a false record. Its impact: 98 open findings and 539 packages become visible, all 47 project manifests and four instruments change verdict semantics, the 12 green projects are re-rendered and the count is expected to fall, and it applies retroactively to tranche 3 and every later tranche review. Its board is issue #526 comment 7077202144 at snapshot `58645942341648d61628029e4e46c5c367c022f6`.
